
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/22358507" title="发布于 2026-08-10 11:46">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">11. 鸿蒙自动化测试6步通关：需求一丢，报告自己出来！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>配套动画视频在：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1NyuA6VEoU/" rel="noopener nofollow">《11. 鸿蒙自动化测试6步通关：需求一丢，报告自己出来！》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1NyuA6VEoU/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》</a>。</p>
<p>前面几节，读需求、生成用例、截图、启停应用、出报告，都分开讲过了；AGENTS.md 和 memory 也配好了。这一节把它们串起来：丢进一份需求文档，最后自动给出 HTML 报告。流程不复杂，就 6 步——读需求、生成用例、测前截图、执行、测后截图、出报告。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="304.19" data-width="2280" data-height="920" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/73096a4200b271ee7c4acb277b21733f3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260810064732216-715332847.png"></p>
<p><strong>1. </strong><strong>读需求</strong></p>
<p>先读需求规格说明书。docx 用 read-docx 脚本，加上 --tables，表格里的元素清单也能读到；pdf 就用 read-pdf。别用 read_file 直接读这类文件，容易出乱码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>python skills/read-docx/scripts/read_docx.py docs/需求规格说明书.docx --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tables

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 若是 pdf：</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
python skills</span>/read-pdf/scripts/read_pdf.py docs/需求规格说明书.pdf</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>2. </strong><strong>生成用例</strong></p>
<p>需求读完，按文档里的功能说明、元素清单和测试要求写用例，再用 generate_test_cases 存到 testcases/test_data.yaml。只生成一次，生成后不要改；元素 ID 也直接用文档里写的，别自己瞎编。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">generate_test_cases(
    test_cases</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[{
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">case_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TC001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">case_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">启动验证</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">description</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">启动后断言首页核心元素存在</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">steps</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
            {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">action</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">assert_exists</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">params</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">selector</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">loginBtn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}},
        ],
    }],
    output_path</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases/test_data.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
)</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>3. </strong><strong>测试前截图</strong></p>
<p>用例文件写好后，先截一张当前屏幕，当作测试开始前的样子。调用 take_screenshot，保存到 before_test.png。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>take_screenshot(save_path=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases/screenshots/before_test.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>4. </strong><strong>执行测试</strong></p>
<p>然后把这份 YAML 交给 execute_test，在真机上把用例跑完。也是只跑一次；跑完会生成 test_results.json，后面写报告要用。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>execute_test(test_data_file=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases/test_data.yaml</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>5. </strong><strong>测试后截图</strong></p>
<p>测试跑完，再截一张，记下结束时的界面。还是用 take_screenshot，文件名改成 after_test.png。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>take_screenshot(save_path=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases/screenshots/after_test.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>6. </strong><strong>生成报告</strong></p>
<p>最后出报告。generate_test_report 会先读 test_results.json，再把测前、测后两张图放进去，生成 test_report.html。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">generate_test_report(
    test_output</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases/test_results.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    output_path</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases/test_report.html</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    screenshots</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases/screenshots/before_test.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases/screenshots/after_test.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    ],
)</span></pre>
</div>
<p>实际跑的时候，不用你一步一步手动点。入口脚本把这 6 步写进任务提示词，把需求文档路径、每一步文件该存哪儿也写清楚，交给 Agent；它按 AGENTS.md 自己调工具，跑完会给出执行总结：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>task = f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">执行自动化测试任务，需求文档路径：{doc_path}。请严格按照 AGENTS.md 定义的完整6步流程执行：<br>1.读取需求文档 <br>2.根据需求规格说明书生成测试用例到testcases/test_data.yaml <br>3.测试前截图到testcases/screenshots/before_test.png <br>4.执行测试（test_data_file=testcases/test_data.yaml） <br>5.测试后截图到testcases/screenshots/after_test.png <br>6.生成报告到testcases/test_report.html。完成后输出执行总结。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>提示词里路径都写清楚了，Agent 就知道该读哪个文件、结果存到哪里。跑完去 testcases/ 看：用例 YAML、两张截图和 HTML 报告应该都在；再对照 Agent 返回的总结，确认 6 步有没有做完。</p>
<p>到这里，从丢进一份需求文档，到自动产出测试报告，整条鸿蒙自动化流程就算通了。</p>
<p>配套动画视频在：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1NyuA6VEoU/" rel="noopener nofollow">《11. 鸿蒙自动化测试6步通关：需求一丢，报告自己出来！》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1NyuA6VEoU/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》</a>。</p>

</div>
